channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 19 November
item.description: New research phases and verification persistence were introduced to the blockchain, and a seal‑growth testing harness was added. Documentation was clarified and hash synchronization was fixed. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, gitbook, documentation, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, openapi-client-scaffold, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 18 November
item.description: Blockchain plans were revised and new evidence matrices were added, while the SDK improved pagination handling and added tests. Documentation for phase plans was also created. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 17 November
item.description: New pattern mapping and research phases were added to the blockchain, and durability checks were introduced. The SDK added user‑list overrides and role seeding, and a template tool was updated for third‑party resolution. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, cmaketemplate.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 16 November
item.description: A merge fix and related tests were applied to the blockchain, and documentation recorded the merge execution. Repositories: SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: Temporary diagnostic prints were added to the wallet verification process. Repositories: GeniusWallet.
